requirements.quote:
QUIC
   treats loss of a packet containing handshake data the same as other
   losses.
requirements.condition: When a QUIC packet containing handshake data is lost.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the loss the same as the loss of other QUIC packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply distinct loss handling solely because the lost packet contains handshake data.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss-recovery test can compare the state transitions and congestion-control effects produced by loss of a handshake-data packet with those produced by an otherwise equivalent packet loss.
